summary: No dataset pairs brachidial spiral direction with shell outline across spire-bearing groups. Dryad holds a few clade-specific studies (athyridide spiralia, Permian neospiriferines, Givetian athyridid 3D reconstructions), the PBDB gives taxon and occurrence counts (Spiriferida 20,024; Atrypida 7,641), and MorphoSource has no brachiopod media. Spire direction would have to be coded from the Treatise or taxonomic papers and joined to outlines.
next_step: Code spiralium direction (outward, inward, discoid) by genus from taxonomic literature, then take outline measures from the Dryad shape datasets or illustrations; check what the three Dryad records actually contain before relying on them.
obstacles_confirmed: Shell shape and arm direction are strongly confounded with phylogeny.
